description: TU Delft provides laboratory investigations on sand samples extracted from the Site-A landslide test location. A mechanical excavator sequentially triggered slope failures by undercutting the slope toe. The source identifies the experiment in Chapter 5 of the associated sand-slope thesis. Coverage: The test-site location is unstated.; 2018. Format: xlsx; zip; txt; pdf. Access: public native descriptive metadata. Licence: CC-BY-4.0. Current file access and cost remain unknown. Caveats: The reviewed native version is version 2. Individual tests, units, sample count, archive completeness and laboratory uncertainty are unstated. The source-defined parent collection concerns breaching flowslides during mining activities. Simulation use is interpreted as mining slope-hazard and geotechnical calibration evidence; no independent model validation is asserted. Related resources in the native collection have separate identities.
